categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Matches the Tests label and explicitly touches sanitizer configuration and test harness runners by adding with_sanitizer_env.py.
categories.rationale: Enables ThreadSanitizer's adaptive delay to help detect rare race conditions and deduplicates sanitizer environment configuration across CI, runners, and documentation. As noted in the PR description, modifying defaults previously required edits across three places, and enabling adaptive delay 'may help to find some kind of rare races more frequently.' This is a worthwhile improvement to testing machinery that can be reasonably deferred.
